description: Per-operation machine-readable schema-contract completeness report covering every operation in the operation registry. JSON Schema files and the registry remain canonical; this report is a derived summary for SDK / conformance tooling and schema-coverage review.

completeness_class_definitions.typed_schema: registry declares a request and/or response artifact schema ref.
completeness_class_definitions.generic_binding: OpenAPI binds the governed generic OperationRequest/OperationResult envelope.
completeness_class_definitions.streaming_frame_schema: success_shape_kind=event_stream; frame contract in a dedicated frame schema.
completeness_class_definitions.binary_or_redirect: success_shape_kind=binary_stream/metadata_headers/redirect; no JSON DTO body by design.
completeness_class_definitions.service_describe: response is the shared ServiceDescribe contract.
completeness_class_definitions.no_request_body: read-only GET/HEAD with no request body and no typed JSON response component.
completeness_class_definitions.schema_missing: OpenAPI declares a typed request/response component not yet mirrored to an artifact schema ref.
